subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — embed a live URL with reload + viewport controls

question: Should OpenClaw ship this modular dashboard and trusted preview widget as bundled, enabled-by-default product surfaces after the persistence and security architecture is corrected?
rationale: The PR introduces a new built-in product surface, persistent data model, plugin lifecycle, external URL behavior, and security boundary; code-level repair cannot determine whether those permanent contracts should exist.

options.title: Approve after architecture repair
options.body: Require a SQLite-backed, security-reviewed dashboard foundation first, then review a narrow corrected preview PR with live proof.

options.title: Hold on the roadmap
options.body: Keep the proposal open but defer implementation landing until maintainers explicitly sponsor the dashboard architecture and rollout.

options.title: Decline the bundled surface
options.body: Do not ship an enabled-by-default dashboard preview and retain existing embed/plugin capabilities as the supported boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after architecture repair
recommendation.body: Require a SQLite-backed, security-reviewed dashboard foundation first, then review a narrow corrected preview PR with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available repository-level product and ownership routing signal; no narrower current-main dashboard owner exists yet.
